_comment: Mutation pilot: report-only, never gates a PR.
Scope is deliberately small: money and tax logic, where a wrong comparison
or a dropped branch is a real financial error. Add files one at a time and
watch the run time before widening the list.
src/taxpacks/*.ts are constant rate tables. ignoreStatic skips them entirely,
so they are not listed: they need their own value assertions instead.
Full rationale and the survivor workflow: docs/testing/mutation-testing.md
